class.name: semantic_traversability_layer/HeightBandLayer
class.description: Classifies point cloud points by height into FREE / STEP_OVER / CAUTION / LETHAL bands and writes corresponding costs into the costmap.

class.name: semantic_traversability_layer/SemanticCostmapLayer
class.description: Reads SemanticObstacleArray messages from the vlm_heuristic_node and writes per-class traversability costs with radius-based footprints.
